historical_research_vs_production: This file contains historical research only. Production simulated outcomes must be stored separately.

AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.candidate_inclusion: All triggered candidates with available entry/exit bars; no manual-trade filter.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.eligible_sample_definition: Complete four-capital-type GEX observation with 60 prior complete GEX observations; D1 07:30 ET entry bar exists; trigger evaluated using D0 or earlier information only.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.entry_rule: Open of the 07:30 America/New_York 30-minute bar on D1, the first US trading session after ObservationDate.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.exit_rule: Close of the final regular-session 30-minute bar on D5; no TP/SL in v1.0.0.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.overlapping_signals: Included independently. Multiple signal codes may coexist on the same observation date.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.position_sizing: Normalized 1.0 notional per signal; no portfolio capital constraint.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.repeated_same_day_signals: At most one instance per signal_code per ObservationDate.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.return_units: percentage points of normalized 1.0 notional directional return
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.sample_size_limitations: Research-selected rules; full history was used for rule discovery, so reported statistics are not untouched out-of-sample estimates.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.slippage: 0.0000% in historical research; results are gross/theoretical.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.transaction_costs: 0.0000% in historical research; results are gross/theoretical.
AMZN_BP_SHARE_SHOCK_REBOUND.win_rate_denominator: wins + losses among resolved instances; unresolved and excluded instances are not in denominator.
